in_tamil.meaning: உபவசிய தரல் (Upavasi yar) - One who guides the ignorant
in_tamil.long_meaning: முரலி (Murali) - One who guides; தர் (tar) - To guide; ர் (r) - The prefix indicating a masculine gender; ஹர் (har) - God

in_telugu.long_meaning: మూఖిచిన (Mūkhichina) - Of the ignorant; ధర్మ (dharma) - Dharma

in_marathi.name: Murlidhar
in_marathi.long_meaning: Murlidhar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Murlidhar is a Sanskrit name derived from 'Murlidhara', which means 'God's protector'. This name is associated with Lord Krishna, who is believed to protect his devotees. The name is also a reflection of one's duty and responsibility towards the divine and society.
